description: This file defines the final class ArraySerializer in the Laminas\Diactoros\Response namespace, providing static methods to serialize ResponseInterface instances to arrays and deserialize arrays back into Response objects. It includes error handling for deserialization issues and depends on external classes such as Response, Stream, Exception, and PSR ResponseInterface.

classes.name: ArraySerializer
classes.description: Provides static methods to serialize a ResponseInterface to an array and reconstruct a Response object from an array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes a ResponseInterface instance into an associative array including status code, reason phrase, protocol version, headers, and body.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Deserializes an array representing a response message into a Response object, with error handling for missing keys or invalid data.

methods.name: getValueFromKey
methods.description: Retrieves a specific key from the serialized response array, throwing an exception if the key is missing.
